newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho shareholders approve hotels sale.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho shareholders approve hotels sale.

text.p: Lonrho Plc said on Monday that its shareholders approved the planned sale of its Metropole Hotels operation at an extraordinary meeting.
In a statement Lonrho said shareholders representing around 54 percent of its ordinary shares supported the sale, while shareholders representing just under one percent voted against.
On October 31 Lonrho announced the sale of its five Metropole Hotels to the Scottish-based group Stakis Plc for 327 million stg.
The sale is part of Lonrho's strategy to focus on its core mining interests by demerging its hotel operations and its African trading business. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
